sections.text_helper: Section 74 "USB HS PHY controller (USBPHYC)" in chapter 74 (USB HS PHY controller (USBPHYC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3927.
sections.section_content:
There are two near-identical instances of USBPHYC
• USBPHYC1 (associated with OTG1)
• USBPHYC2 (associated with OTG2)
– includes one additional control bit concerning hardware debug (HDP)
For a more complete system view of the USB controllers and PHYs, refer to the block
diagram of the main OTG controller.
